title: What a rice screenshot shows about its terminals
description: One entry per r/unixporn screenshot, written by looking at the picture once. Facts only, no images. Boxes are fractions of the screenshot (0-1) so they work at any resolution.

focus.description: terminal: the terminals are the point of the shot; mixed: terminals share it with other apps/widgets; other: terminals are absent, tiny or covered

box.description: x, y, width, height as fractions of the screenshot

panes.description: splits inside this window (tmux/zellij/terminal splits), 1 if none

surface.description: solid bg, see-through to the wallpaper, or an image inside the terminal

layout.description: how the terminals are arranged: one window; one window split into panes; several tiled windows; several overlapping/floating windows; many small windows each with one job (monitor, clock, fetch...); a horizontally scrolling strip; no terminal visible

complexity.description: 1 one terminal with a shell; 2 one terminal with fetch/art, or 2 areas; 3 three or four areas, or a full TUI app; 4 four to six areas with several TUI apps; 5 a wall of six or more

accent.description: the one accent color in the terminals, if there is a clear one

note.description: one line: what makes the terminal part work (or fail)
